text:
rachael: heads-up — phobos21b-int4 on dedicated-staging threw repeated OOMs during a production-like ramp test at ~04:05. Suspect fragmentation + aggressive prefetch + high max_new_tokens.
perf-bot: run-failure: cluster=ded-stg-2 node=a2-high task=phobos21b-canary reason=OOM_kv_reserve
dan: can you paste the minimal repro and current defaults? also which compile/quant flags were used?
rachael: minimal log: 
```
[04:05:10] config: prefetch_window=48 prefetch_slots=5 max_new_tokens=400 batch_size=24 quant=int4 opt=packed_kernel
[04:05:10] kv_reserve_request 10.8GB -> kv_reserved_total 41.3GB
[04:05:11] GPU OOM allocating 3.9GB for kv_prefetch
```
otto: quick hypothesis — int4 improves footprint but our prefetch math multiplies kv allocation by batch_size * prefetch_slots * ceil(max_new_tokens/128). With 400 tokens that's 4 chunks and spills. Also warmstart path doesn't trim early.
irene: i ran a scaled bench locally with --cold=true. Baseline: peak=50.2GB, OOMs=2. After patching max_new_tokens=128 and prefetch_window=12, peak=35.1GB, OOMs=0. Latency P95 increased from 190ms->230ms.
dan: important to check quality delta from quant+shorter max_new_tokens on our codegen and summarization suites. @qa-bot can you schedule the eval run for the 3 suites and 2-shot convo set?
qa-bot: scheduled eval: phobos21b/int4/2026-04-07-1778123456. Will upload CSVs to /evals/phobos21b/1778123456.
rachael: propose config diff to try first (canary):
```
models:
  phobos21b:
    defaults:
      max_new_tokens: 128
      prefetch_window: 12
      prefetch_slots: 2
      batch_size: 12
      prefetch_mode: gradual
      prefetch_ramp_requests: 3
      slot_compactor: soft_start
      kv_trim_on_evict: true
```
otto: +recommendation: add metric kv_reserved_peak and kv_fragmentation_pct to tracing, and enable soft compactor during off-peak cron. Also add an opt-in kernel flag `packed_kernel=false` for canary to compare against perf.
dan: run quickbench: `bench.sh --model phobos21b --runs 300 --batch 12 --max-new 128 --prefetch 12 --coldstart`
perf-bot: bench result: peak_gpu_mem=35.1GB avg_latency=82ms p95=230ms OOMs=0 (prev: peak=50.2GB OOMs=2). Artifacts: s3://redwood-ci/phobos21b/canary-1778123456
irene: QA ran the evals quick-pass: codegen exact-match down 0.8%, rouge for summarization down 0.6%, convo turn-level coherence unchanged. All within our 1% alert threshold, but we'll keep a close eye.
dan: ok. plan: 1) submit canary config PR with prefetch=gradual + max_new_tokens=128 + metrics; 2) deploy 10% eu-west for 4h with packed_kernel disabled; 3) run full eval and perf bench; 4) if no quality regression >1% and no OOMs, increase to 60% and enable packed_kernel for comparison; 5) if fragmentation persists, flip on aggressive compaction cron. tagging @oncall-infra for kernel knob if compactor interacts poorly with scheduler.
rachael: I'll open the PR and attach bench logs. Also opening an eval-alert to fire if any metric drops >1.5% over baseline. :eyes:
otto: small note — consider a runtime change to cap per-request prefetch allocation proportional to batch_size and current free_kv_pool to avoid spikes during bursts. File a follow-up RFC?
dan: agree — please draft RFC after canary results. Thanks everyone.
perf-bot: PR CI passed, canary deployment started. Monitoring windows created.
rachael: will report back with canary summary and the /evals CSV links once ready.
